title: I couldn't figure it out on my own
text: I couldn't figure it out on my own. I ended up having a friend come over and show me how this machine works. I like it, it saves food in the freezer longer but I don't think I will be using it much, too much of a pain to set up and do.

product_metadata.title: Vacuum Sealer Machine, Food Sealers Vacuum Packing Machine, AFMAT Food Vacuum Sealer, Automatic Vacuum System for Food Savers, Built-in Cutter, Better Sealability w/ 2 Heating Wires, 5 Modes-Black
features: 【KINDLY REMINDER】Before turning on the vacuum sealing function, please press down firmly on both ends of the cover and hear two obvious click sounds to ensure that the cover is completely closed. (If you could not hear the locked "click" sound, please press the end harder with your both hands.) The machine will not work properly if the cover is not closed tightly. Besides, please wait for 20 seconds before the next operation, or the machine may not work due to overheating protection.

【POWERFUL VACUUM SEALER MACHINE】With Built-in sophisticated double-layer air sealing technology and extended 30cm heat sealing strip, AFMAT Vacuum Sealer Machine provides perfect reservation to meat, fruits, nuts, vegetables, snacks etc. The excellent food sealer produces great suction power of 60kPa to extract all air from the bag, ensuring the fresh of your food fresh and the high efficiency vacuum sealing.

【CONVENIENT & USER-FRIENDLY DESIGN】 AFMAT food sealer designed with an adjustable vacuum roll holder and a built-in cutter, enabling you to adjust it to suit various-sized rolls and cut the vacuum sealer bags in desired size to prevent bag-wasting. A removable Drip Tray it is convenient for you to clean and maintain after using. Please press the side buttons and open the lid after the Indicator Light goes out.

【CUSTOMIZE YOUR TASK WITH 4 MODES】 The vacuum sealer machine features 4 useful modes: Dry/Wet, Normal Vacuum, Soft Vacuum, Seal Only. You can choose the most appropriate preservation methods according to different kind of food types, texture and cooking requirements. Press “Stop” to further control the vacuum pressure needed.The “Outside Vac” supports vacuum jar or bottle that with specific exhaust hole on the top. The outer diameter of the hole should be 0.5cm for the tube connection.
